# FDGA013

> DO NOT use spaces after or before square braces.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.2 Space Usage.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0055
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
csharp_space_within_square_brackets = false
csharp_space_before_open_square_brackets = false
```

## From the book

```csharp
Right: x = dataArray[index];
Wrong: x = dataArray[ index ];
```
